lines.en: It’s cold again, though I’m not sure why.

Less than twelve hours ago, around the time I was enveloped in the flesh of a girl whose name just found her way onto paper, the fabric of my shirt stuck to my skin from sweat brought on by the summer sun.
The sun is dead now. And the moon is simply too small and too dormant to bleed the same heat its older brother does.
Ayane is gone, though she won’t be joining Noriko at the hotel.
Instead, she’s headed home to ponder over a tangible list of my misdeeds that aren’t really misdeeds because I never promised myself to any one person in the first place.
Which makes the feelings I’m feeling right now feel a lot more confusing.
: Yeah?
: Sensei! What in the world is taking you so long? We’re all waiting for you, you know!
: Right...
: Where am I supposed to go again?
: Home! For the Midnight Mom Mosh. Even though it’s getting closer to 1:00 AM now, which makes the name feel kind of pointless.
: Okay...I’ll be there soon. Sorry.
: You don’t have to apologize. I know you were doing stuff with Ayane. Just get here as fast as you can, okay?
: I love-
I hang up the phone and fill in the rest of her sentence with words she’d never say.
Hearing the truth would just make this walk ten times longer...and the weight of a fulfilled promise ten times heavier.
I wouldn’t be able to handle that when I’m already being crushed beneath its weight.
How can I be expected to carry on like everything is normal?
How am I supposed to enjoy participating in this ridiculous contest when I know that the girl who won just a short while ago is bawling her eyes out on her bedroom floor because of me?
There were too many names on the list. I should have marked down less.
I should have kept the one signature in ink as the only one on the page and thrown myself into a lie that we could hide behind until we’re sent back to the beginning.
Maybe then, she’ll be able to fall for a version of me that won’t neglect her the way I do.
Maybe then, she’ll be able to live a life devoid of rooftops and resets and just enjoy her time in this endless cycle.
Blissfully ignorant.
Happily unaware.
I thought up a poem on the way home.
It goes something like this.
Roses are red.
Violets are pretty.
I wonder what life’s like outside of this city.
: Sensei.
I’m fine now.
Not because I’m over it.
But because I have to be.
Or I will hurt everyone else inside of this room.
And keep them locked in the attic to use whenever I see fit.
But that’s okay because now I’ve got dramatic action music to lighten the mood.
Time for mom stuff.
: There are too many women in this house.
: Correction. There are two women and a bunch of young girls.
If they were all women, MY BONER WOULDN’T BE THIS BIG! HAHAHA!
: Whatever they are, it feels wrong. But I can’t even do anything about it because turning down the generous donation from the Produce Delivery Administration would be a bad idea.
: Well, don’t look at me all angry.
: But I have nowhere else to direct my rage since I have to be a good host.
: That is your problem, not mine.
: Uhh...hi. I’m sorry for speaking out of turn, but I was worried there wouldn’t be another opportunity to say that and it would be weird if I was just here and...not saying anything at all.
: Hey, Io. I still have your video game if you want it back.
: Why do you have Io’s-
: Oh...uhh...Why don’t you keep it? For the next time I decide to stop by.
: Next time?
: That’s right. I went in your room and everything.
: You what?
: Like a panther stalking her prey...or a viper waiting to strike...Io Ichimonji is never detected before it’s already too late.
: You should probably take a page out of her book then, since taking up an attack pose in my kitchen makes you seem like a pretty lousy kunoichi.
: Or could it be...you’re just an easy target?
: Well, it wouldn’t be the first time you’ve taken me down, if you know what I mean.
: I don’t. Please explain, dearest uncle.
: Me neither. Please explain, dearest Uta.
: Wshhhhh!
: Or just hide behind him, I guess.
: Sensei. Please make your way to the living room so we can get this over with. I’d like to have a few words with our non-adult guests.
: Sure. Just don’t get any blood on the floor. It’ll stain the wood.
: I mean, that really depends on the type of wood. This looks like-
: It will stain.
: I know it will.
: Uhh...
: Hey, everybody. Sorry for the wait. I had to ruin someone’s life.
: All in a day’s work, I suppose.
: See? Makoto knows how it is.
: No worries at all! And, let me just say, I absolutely love what you’ve done with your shed.
: This is my house.
: Oh, stop. I’m not nearly as gullible as my daughter. I won’t fall for such an obvious prank.
: Well, you’re certainly just as humble as her.
: This is my first time ever staying up this late! And it would be quite exhilarating if not for the fact that this dress has been nearly suffocating me for hours now!
: Grin and bear it, dear. This is what it means to be a lady.
: Yes, Mother. You always know best.
: Yo! I didn’t bring my briefcase this time. But I’ve got a whole bunch of other tricks up my sleeve that’ll help me take down Tsubasa here.
: I would have worn sleeves as well if I had known we were allowed to hide useful items in them. Up until now, I was under the assumption we would be fighting fairly.
: Why did I decide to tag along for this again? Can someone remind me?
: Because you’re your mother’s official representative and not being here would have disqualified you!
: Where the hell did you come from?
: Oh, you know me. Probably blended in with your curtains or something.
: Being disqualified sounds like a dignified way to lose. Let’s do that, Mom.
: More dignified than being true Miyamuras and getting our asses pounded? No way.
: Please don’t equate our surname to the act of “ass-pounding.” At least half of us that remain are decently civilized.
: Which means that the other half of us are versatile and ready to take it in any hole at any time so long as the mood is right!
: Oh, will we be golfing? Should I contact my caddy?
: We will not be golfing! But I will be exercising my role as judge to award Tsubasa an extra ten points for being adorable and aloof!
: Oh, yay! We’re winning!
: And then Maki an extra ten points for being way braver than I could ever be.
: Oh, shoot. We’re no longer winning.
: Makoto! That’s ten more points than you said I was going to score tonight! Are you proud of me yet?!
: Absolutely not.
: I’m proud of you, Mrs. Miyamura! It takes a great deal of skill to tie my mother in anything and I believe you will be a worthy adversary for our competition tonight.
: Please don’t encourage her.
: Okay, okay. Everybody shut up.
: We’re all tired as Hell, so I’m going to explain the rules of this contest now so we can breeze straight through it before going home and getting some sleep.
: Maki and Tsubasa will compete in a series of three tests to determine which one of them is more stereotypically motherly.
: The first test will be simple. The two of you will cook a signature dish for Sensei- who will be roleplaying as your son.
: Absolutely not.
: You don’t have a say in the matter. You’re the only one here with a dick.
: Attached to him, sure. But I’ve got at least ten rubber ones in the trunk of my car that beg to differ!
: Fucking Christ, Mom. Please.
: The second and third competitions will be revealed when we get to them. But it’s important to note that these competitions will also relate to the standard duties of the average mother.

: The subjects in these rounds have been chosen by the mothers’ daughters as their “areas of expertise” so, should an unexpected winner emerge from either of these rounds, we’ll likely have a full-on winner.
: Does anyone have any questions? Or are we ready to get this show on the road?
: I have a question for Maki. Is that allowed?
: I mean...I guess? So long as you’re not trying to sabotage her strategy or anything.
: Of course not. I simply wish to know why she has so many rubber penises in the trunk of her car.
: Mother! You shouldn’t say “rubber penis” in public! It’s uncouth!
: I know, dear. But that’s just so many of them.
: Now that you mention it, I am also curious. Ten seems excessive.
: Permission to pause the contest for several hours while I explain the exact needs for at least ten rubber penises at all times?
: Permission denied. Round one starts now.
: Ladies! Positions!
: How do you want me? Doggy? Missionary? Or are we just going to do this standing up?
: Oh my. Is such a thing possible?
: Yeah, but only if the heights work well together. It gets really weird when-
: In the kitchen, damn it!
: Jeez, fine. But I’m checking if the stove is on first because I am not making that same mistake a fourth time.
: Ugh...
: Okay, girls! The PDA has provided every ingredient you’d ever need to cook a nice Japanese comfort dish!
: You’ve got thirty minutes to both prep and finish your dish, and the person who will rank them is none other than your son, Sensei! Who...also happens to be in the kitchen for some reason.
: I’m worried Maki is going to break something.
: I am also worried about that. I can’t even remember the last time I actually tried cooking anything.
: It has been quite a while for me as well, but I’m sure that I can remember something.
: Don’t worry, Mother. If there is anything I know about you, it’s that you’re capable of doing anything you set your mind to!
: How come my daughter isn’t ever that unconditionally supportive?
: She was of your husband, wasn’t she?
: Yeah, but unless you’ve got a time machine in your vegetable crisper, I doubt that will come in handy right now.
: That’s it! No more talking! Get cooking or you both lose!
Tsubasa quickly begins sifting through all of the bags and searching for whatever ingredients she needs for her dish while Maki...
Uhh...
: Woah. What the fuck is this thing?
: Oh! That would be a geoduck. It’s a type of Pacific clam that’s often used in fine dining and-
: It looks kind of like a dick, doesn’t it?
: Do they come in that size?
: Boy do I have some videos I have to show you.
: Tsubasa, come here. Touch my geoduck. I swear I’ll be quick.
: I don’t know if I should. My daughter is watching.
: Mom! Put down the fucking dick clam and cook something already! If you don’t win this round, we’re basically screwed!
: Hey, that doesn’t sound so bad.
: MOM!
: Don’t yell at me, Makoto! I’m trying!
: You’re literally not!
: What am I looking at here?
: What I’ve prepared for you today is whole quail with a side of exotic, stir fried vegetables and a veal demi glace. Please enjoy to your heart’s content.
: It looks like it was eaten already.
: Yeah, that was me.
: Maki, you can’t eat your opponent’s food! You’re not Tsubasa’s son!
: To be fair, neither am-
: YES YOU ARE, SENPAI! JUST ACCEPT IT!
: This is my fault. I offered the dish to Maki out of the kindness of my heart and assumed I would have enough time left over to make more.
: Unfortunately, that was not the case and I was left with nothing to offer but the remainder of her meal.
: Okay, so Tsubasa loses. But what about Maki? What did you make?
: Sashimi.
: It’s just a whole fish.
: Please enjoy to your heart’s content.
: I have no idea how I’m supposed to cut it.
: What, and you think I do?
: They’re always talking on those cooking shows about deconstructed this and deconstructed that. Just look at it as reconstructed sashimi and call it a day.
: They both lose.
: If you didn’t say it, I was going to.
: On to round two then!
: OOC, how are you?
: I thought you weren’t supposed to break character until after the costume contest was over?
: No one’s listening to us right now and I want to make sure you’re doing okay.
: Yeah, I’m fine.
: We can leave now if you’re not comfortable, you know.
: I’ve been thinking about it. I just also feel like that would draw too much attention to us and I like Sensei too much to hit him with an Irish goodbye.
: I’m a little surprised you asked to tag along in the first place. I thought for sure you were going to go back to the hotel.
: Yeah.
: I didn’t realize which contest this was.
Subject two, chosen by Touka, tests a mother’s ability to help her “child” with his or her homework.
As such, I am joined by Maki on the floor of my living room- where I must pretend to have no idea what I’m talking about and lean on her for advice.
There is no chance at all that this is going to end well.
: I can’t watch. I’m going to be too disappointed.
: Don’t worry, Makoto. If your mother is even a fraction as good of a teacher as you, I’m sure everything will be just fine.
: So...whatcha need help with, Old Sport?
: Please don’t call me “Old Sport.”
: But that’s what I always call you. You’re “Old Sport” and I’m “Big Momma.” Now tell Big Momma what subject you need help with.
: Physics.
: Jiggle physics?
: Regular physics.
: I see.
: Have you tried Google?
: The Internet is down.
: Want to watch a movie while we wait for it to come back up? I think I’ve got a few DVDs lying around that we can dust off.
: The power is out. All I can do right now is this physics homework.
: Have you tried asking your father?
: He’s dead.
: Can you wait until tomorrow?
: It’s due tomorrow.
: I see.
: Welp, Big Momma’s done all she can do, Old Sport. But she knows you’re a smart cookie and that you can handle this all on your own.
: My, your mother really is useless in this department, isn’t she?
: Yes, but at least she never called me “Old Sport.”
: ...and that’s everything there is to know about dark matter.
: I can’t take this anymore. Somebody slap me when it’s over.
: The concept of having a mother who is actually able to explain anything related to science is simply too much for me to comprehend.
: There’s a reason I chose this subject after all.
: Up until recently, I always struggled with the instructors that were chosen for me. Meaning that my mother would often step in and teach me instead.
: She’s the smartest woman I know. Perhaps even smarter than Nodoka, and I often worry that Nodoka’s brain will swell to a size so large that it begins to seep out of her ears.
: I’ve decided I want your mom to win as well, Touka. But not because I like her. I want her to win because she’s never carried a box full of lube into my house.
: Is that another middle class custom I’m not yet familiar with?
: No. Makoto’s mom is just a whore.
Subject three, chosen by Makoto, is a Hail Mary of a topic choice that will either result in a crushing victory or the worst defeat possible for Maki.
It is also one of the most uncomfortable situations I have ever been in considering everyone has filtered into my room to watch me receive “the talk.”
: My dearest Son...you’ve probably noticed by now that your body is undergoing certain...changes.
: You’re likely feeling things you’ve never felt before. Becoming interested in girls when, just last year, you were talking about how “icky” they were.
: But that’s fine. In fact, it’s completely normal.
: I hate this.
: Yeah, this is weird as fuck. Not gonna lie.
: You see, there comes a time in everyone’s life like that...Where we begin to become more conscious of the opposite sex...and the ways we feel about them.
: Which is why it’s important for me to tell you about this now before you wind up having questions further down the line.
: Boys and girls...are structurally different from one another. It’s one of the many beauties of life.
: And what you’re experiencing right now is your body...activating. Preparing to one day create children of your own so the family name can live on.
: Do you know how that works, Son? How babies are made?
: Son?
: No...please tell me...
: Have we reached a good stopping point? Even if it’s for the competition, I feel quite strange explaining the process of sexual intercourse to an adult male.
: And I feel incredibly emasculated.
: Aww! But we were just getting to the good part!
: You can do whatever you’d like with the “good part,” Maki. I simply feel a little...strange about this and am confident in my performance up until now.
: Fine, fine, fine. Step aside. I got this.
: Sit back...relax...and watch how it’s done, y’all.
: Hey again, Old Sport. Just wanted to pop in and talk to you for a little while about the changes your body is going through and why it’s normal to be confused at a time like this.
: I understand just how overwhelming all of these new feelings must be for you because I was the same exact way back when I was your age.
: But you don’t have to worry, because I’ll tell you everything you need to know and answer any questions that you might have about the wonders that are puberty and sex.
: I’ve even brought visual aids so I can show you firsthand how everything works!
: Oh my lord.
: Oh my lord.
: There must be some sort of rule against this, correct? There is no way that unsheathing such...vulgar items in front of one’s child is acceptable.
: I think that’s up to Sensei to decide. Also, dayum that thing is thick.
: One thing to know when dealing with Sensei is that the most perverted option practically always wins.
: Yeah, Maki takes this round. And since Tsubasa won the last one, that means we’re tied at one win a piece.
: So...do both floors get a point now? Or is there going to be some sort of tiebreaker round?
: Should I make more coffee?
: Nah, that’s enough MILF energy for one day. Let’s just clear out of here and make Sensei choose a winner. That seems like the easiest solution to all of this.
: Pick me and you can keep the onahole.
: I heard that, Mrs. Miyamura. And bribery will not be tolerated.
: Bribery will probably be tolerated.
: I told you, Touka. The perverted option always wins.
: Well...it was a hard fought battle. And if there’s anything I learned today, it’s that motherhood is no easy task.
: But for every child out there who needs someone to relate to-
: Blah, blah, blah. Just choose a fucking winner so we can get out of here and sleep.
: Fine. But only because I am also tired.
: The winner of tonight’s...mom contest thing is...
Maki
: Maki.
: Hah...see, Mom? I told you that-
: Wait, what?
: Yes, what?!
: How did my mother lose when her competition brought out sex toys and sabotaged her quail?! This is-
: Touka, dear. There will be times in our lives where we will lose. And when those times come, we must lose with grace.
: But-
: Enough. There will be other contests.
: I won?!
: I mom’ed?!
: Was...the onahole really all it took?
: That wasn’t it.
: Tsubasa did great and was probably the more conventional mother. I just liked Maki’s informal approach to parenting a little more.
: This is, like...the fifth best thing that has ever happened to me!
: Well, now I’m just curious to know the other four.
: But unfortunately, we don’t have time for that! The victory for the first floor has been added to my official Dorm Wars notebook and we are now free to leave!
Tsubasa
: Tsubasa.
: Wow. What a crazy turn of events.
: Yeah...kind of saw that coming. But I did accidentally get my hopes up a little, so...
: Congrats, Tsubasa. You’re the better mom.
: You did it, Mother! You have once again proven your worth against someone significantly less qualified than you! I have never been more proud!
: While I’m humbled by your decision, I would like to add that my rival in today’s contest did an exceptional job as well.
: Maki, you were a worthy adversary and I applaud both your resolve and determination.
: I would also appreciate the opportunity to...umm...
: How should I put this?...
: Check out the haul in the trunk of my car?
: If you’d be so kind, yes.
: Mother?
: Mother, where are you going?
: I’ll be right back, dear. Please stay in the house for a moment. I don’t want your pride in me to be reduced to nothing in the blink of an eye.
: Alright! With Tsubasa’s victory, the second floor has gained another tally in my official Dorm Wars notebook and we are now free to leave!
: Either head back to your dorms or take a ride in the complimentary shuttle to our hotel room provided to us by the wonderful and extremely affluent Tsukioka family!
: Or...I don’t know! Crash here if your name is Sensei or you’re lazy or something.
: Great idea, Imani. I think I’ll do just that.
: Absolutely not! No!
: No?
: Yeah!
: Is it yeah or no? I’m confused.
: Yeah, no!
: That didn’t help.
: What I’m saying is that you have to come to the hotel because that’s where I’m sleeping and you have to sleep in the same building as me!
: The red one speaks the truth. Like an arrow, she has one path. A path that you, too...are destined to walk.
: Where did you get those shuriken?
: I found them.
: Sensei!
: Fine, Jesus. I’ll go back to the hotel. It just seems like a waste when my bed is like twenty feet away.
: Hm? Senpai? You’re coming back to the hotel with us? I could have sworn you were going to stay behind.
: That’s not a problem, is it? Because I don’t think I’m allowed to stay behind anymore.
: Uhh...no! Of course not. It’s totally fine. It’s just...
: Ahh, fuck it. You’ll find out when we get there.
Maki’s affection has increased to [maki_love]!
Tsubasa’s affection has increased to [tsubasa_love]!
First Floor: [dorm1war2points]\nSecond Floor: [dorm2war2points]
You have received a new picture message from Nodoka Nagasawa!
